review: The House of Spiders: The Ring Nursefather Hong Lu is an interesting Bleed and Charge Identity who synergises with The House of Spiders: The Ring Apprentice Faust Identity and to a certain degree, with other Ring faction Identities. First, he has a total of 5 unique statuses: - Corpus Ingredients is a unique Charge that works the same way as a normal Charge does. - Viewing the Tableau starts at 21 stacks upon Encounter start, loses 2 stacks on turn end and gives Ring Hong Lu 2 Protection if The Ring Apprentice Faust is on the field. More of this status will be explained in the passive section. - Artwork: Tibia, obtained upon spending 10 Corpus Ingredients, allows him to switch state and gain bonuses, up to 3 Base Power, additional +1 Potency and Count for Bleed infliction and 10% damage. These buffs are gained based on Corpus Ingredients Potency. - Corpus Theater randomly grants the unit
